description: This file contains a comprehensive test suite for the 'git fsck' command, implementing numerous tests for object verification, corruption detection, repository consistency, and other related functionalities within a Git project. It references various external helper scripts and performs operations on a Git repository to validate the integrity and correctness of Git objects and repository states.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve the file path of a Git object based on its SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Deletes a Git object file given its SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: create_repo_missing
methods.description: Creates a test repository with specific objects missing to test fsck handling of missing objects.

methods.name: corrupt_index_checksum
methods.description: Shell function that corrupts the index checksum for testing.
